quote: A proverb about his valour is famous: "Where is King Bhoj, and where is Gangu the oilman!" (*Kान राजा भोज ने कान गंगू तेली*). In princely Malwi it is said thus: *"Kathe Raja Bhoj ne kathe Gangu Teli."* The root of this proverb is in fact in accord with history. In the above proverb, the *teli* (oilman) is also called *telan* (oil-woman): *"Kathe Raja Bhoj ne kathe Gangi Telan."* This reading of the proverb is closer to its origin, because King Bhoj's contemporary Gangeyadeva Kalachuri is known. The folk turned Gangeyadeva into "Gangi"; and turned "Telang" into "Telan." Thus Gangeyadeva Telang became Gangi Telan.
